body:
The Word of the Lord to Evangelicals … a fictional tale in ebook form:

Nook: http://www.barnesandnoble.com/w/books/1109828463?ean=2940014180252&itm=1&usri=word+of+lord+evangelicals

Kindle: http://www.amazon.com/The-Word-Lord-Evangelicals-ebook/dp/B007Q77XV4/ref=sr_1_1?s=digital-text&ie=UTF8&qid=1333414515&sr=1-1

For the cost of a cup of coffee, I wrote these little ebooks to deliver a rich dose of laughter, pleasure, flavor, and warmth, plus some caffeine for the soul. This new release joins The Word of the Lord to Democrats and will be joined by The Word of the Lord to Republicans and The Girl With the Dove Tattoo soon.
